notes.subject: וחדלת מעזב לו
notes.rationale: Raitim olsem: 'yu wantim lusim' o 'yu stap na no lukim' — KJV/JPS skelim olsem kwestin o pasin; inf. abs. עזב תעזב i mekim strongpela: 'yu mas helpim tru'.

notes.subject: עזב תעזב
notes.rationale: Infinitive absolute + yusim-im futa — 'helpim tru'; Tok Pisin i no gat wankain inf. abs., mi usim 'mas … tru' pasin.

notes.subject: עזב
notes.rationale: Hibru עזב i tok 'laisim/lesimim' tok i go; long konteks em i mining 'helpim kirapim' — KJV 'help', ASV 'release'.

translation: Sapos yu lukim donki bilong man i biruarim long yu, em i daun long graun ananit long kago bilong em, na yu laik lusim ⟨em⟩, no — yu mas helpim em wantaim.

tokens.gloss: bilong man i biruarim long yu
